findings.claim: Fallback chain now depends on per-site SiteSetting.default_locale, but the process-wide translation LRU cache in I18n.translate (lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:72) is keyed only on key+locale+backend id; in multisite one site's fallback text is served to another site, and after an admin changes default_locale stale fallback strings persist until eviction.
findings.evidence: FallbackLocaleList#[] returns [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]; cache key is "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}" on a singleton @cache; multisite via RailsMultisite (app/jobs/base.rb:150); default_locale is refresh: true (config/site_settings.yml:59-62). Previously fallback went to I18n.default_locale, identical across sites. Reasoned; proposed failing spec: default_locale=de, locale=fr, t(k) missing in fr; then default_locale=es, t(k) returns cached German.
findings.reason: Three seats independently, concrete source citations for both halves (key and chain); regression introduced by this patch. Include default_locale in cache key or move resolution so cache cannot cross sites. Unverified until a red multisite spec exists.

findings.claim: Fallback locales (site default, :en) are lazily loaded only via I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! in ApplicationController#set_locale; Sidekiq jobs, mailers, I18n.with_locale callers and rake tasks never load them, so fallback silently yields 'translation missing', which the cache then pins.
findings.evidence: I18n.translate loads only config.locale (translate_accelerator.rb:68); app/jobs/base.rb:151 sets I18n.locale without ensure_loaded!; app/services/post_alerter.rb:138 and lib/post_destroyer.rb:102 use I18n.with_locale. Partly pre-existing for :en, but the new site-default hop is also unloaded off the request path. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Raised by all four seats (mattpocock as Minor, ponytail out of remit); normalised to Important since emails/notifications are user-facing. Load fallback chain inside I18n.translate/load_locale instead of a controller hook, which also removes the need for the hook.

findings.claim: Change adds no tests for the new fallback order, FallbackLocaleList, I18n.ensure_loaded!, or fallback/cache interaction, and enables fallbacks in all environments.
findings.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md step 3: 'Include tests, and ensure they pass'; git show --stat ecfa17b5a7 lists no spec/ files; spec/components/freedom_patches has no translate_accelerator spec.
findings.reason: Documented project standard breach with direct evidence; the missing specs are the red tests the two Important correctness findings need anyway.

findings.claim: Fallbacks were previously on only in production/profile/cloud66; the initializer now enables them in development and test, hiding missing translations behind English text and possibly changing specs that expect missing-translation output.
findings.evidence: Patch removes config.i18n.fallbacks = true from three env files and unconditionally includes I18n::Backend::Fallbacks in the initializer.
findings.reason: Likely intentional (feature is 'localization fallbacks'); behaviour change is undocumented but not a defect. ponytail: confirm intent with the author; gate on env only if dev visibility of missing keys is wanted.

findings.claim: New public I18n.ensure_loaded! duplicates load_locale's own already-loaded guard (checked inside the mutex), and its @loaded_locales ||= [] is inconsistent with translate, which dereferences @loaded_locales unguarded.
findings.evidence: load_locale (L46-60) returns early when @loaded_locales.include?(locale); reload! sets @loaded_locales = [] at boot (L40); translate (L68) calls @loaded_locales.include? without nil guard.
findings.reason: Cheap deletion: call I18n.load_locale directly from FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!. Advisory; non-blocking. Moot if the fallback-loading fix moves loading into translate.

findings.claim: '# order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb' comment implies an ordering directive that nothing reads; ordering is purely alphabetical file-name sort.
findings.evidence: No code in the repo parses 'order:'; Rails loads config/initializers in sorted order; no other initializer uses the convention.
findings.reason: One-line deletion (or numbered filename if ordering matters); prevents a misleading maintenance hazard. Advisory, non-blocking.

findings.claim: FallbackLocaleList inherits Hash but only overrides []; fetch/keys/each/to_h return empty or raise, misrepresenting I18n.fallbacks.
findings.evidence: i18n 0.7.0 (Gemfile.lock:126) Backend::Fallbacks only calls I18n.fallbacks[locale]; the Hash storage is never populated. Gem source not read; from reviewer knowledge.
findings.reason: Advisory, no current caller uses other Hash methods; ponytail: drop '< Hash' when the class is next touched. Not verified against installed gem source.

findings.claim: New comments (including a TODO) breach the 'DO NOT ADD COMMENTS unless asked' standard.
findings.reason: The cited rule is the reviewing user's personal ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md style for code they author, not a documented standard of this repository; CONTRIBUTING.md has no such rule (mattpocock seat checked CONTRIBUTING conventions and found no breach). Minor, so no verifier required.
